name: dotfiles
description: This directory contains synchronized dotfiles managed through Syncthing for consistent configuration across Mac and Linux devices.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:shell && npm run format:check && npm run lint:markdown
scripts.lint:shell: zsh -n shell/.zshenv && zsh -n shell/zdotdir/.zshenv && zsh -n shell/.zshrc && zsh -n shell/.zprofile && bash -n bootstrap-linux.sh
